verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a scheduling SaaS, but the evidence pack documents no first-party export of user data in open formats. The API docs cover creating and rescheduling bookings, managing event types and schedules, and registering webhooks, not bulk export. The MIT-licensed Cal.diy fork and the GDPR compliance claim concern self-hosting and regulation, which are adjacent and earn no credit for data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
